title: Asymptotic prime divisors and Vasconcelos invariant
summary: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring, $I$ an ideal of $R$, and $M$ a finitely generated $R$-module. In this article, we prove that $$\mathrm{Ass}_R(M/I^{n} M) = \mathrm{Ass}_R(0:_{M} I) \cup \mathrm{Ass}_R(I^{n-1} M/I^{n} M) \text{ for all } n \gg 0.$$ We then investigate the asymptotic behaviour of the (local) Vasconcelos invariant of $M/I^{n} M$ as a function of $n$, when $R$ is $\mathbb{N}$-graded, $I$ is homogeneous, and $M$ is $\mathbb{Z}$-graded.
